HINU 100.title: Introductory Hindi-Urdu I
HINU 100.description: Spoken Hindi and Urdu, and written Hindi.

HINU 101.title: Introductory Hindi-Urdu II
HINU 101.description: Continuation of HINU 100. Recommended pre-requisite: HINU 100.

HINU 102.title: Introductory Hindi-Urdu
HINU 102.description: Spoken and written Hindi and Urdu. As of 2011W,

HINU 200.title: Intermediate Hindi-Urdu
HINU 200.description: Conversation and grammar; an introduction to Hindi literature; an introduction to the Urdu script. As of 2011W, Recommended pre-requisites: one of HINU 101, HINU 102.

HINU 201.title: Intermediate Hindi-Urdu I
HINU 201.description: Conversation and grammar; an introduction to Hindi literature; an introduction to the Urdu script. Recommended pre-requisite: HINU 101.

HINU 202.title: Intermediate Hindi-Urdu II
HINU 202.description: Continuation of HINU 201. Recommended pre-requisite: HINU 201.

HINU 205.title: Introduction to the Devanagari Script
HINU 205.description: The writing system of Hindi for those with some background in the spoken language. May be taken at the same time as HINU 200.

HINU 300.title: Advanced Hindi-Urdu
HINU 300.description: Further study of the grammar of Hindi and Urdu; advanced conversation; literary readings in Hindi and Urdu; Hindi film. As of 2011W, Recommended pre-requisites: one of HINU 200, HINU 202.

HINU 301.title: Advanced Hindi-Urdu I
HINU 301.description: Further study of the grammar of Hindi and Urdu; advanced conversation; literary readings in Hindi and Urdu; Hindi film. Recommended pre-requisite: HINU 202.

HINU 302.title: Advanced Hindi-Urdu II
HINU 302.description: Continuation of HINU 301. Recommended pre-requisite: HINU 301.

HINU 305.title: Introduction to the Perso-Arabic (Urdu) Script
HINU 305.description: The writing system of Urdu for those with some background in the spoken Urdu/Hindi language. This course is recommended for students who have taken HINU_V 102, or placement approval. For more information on placement approval, please visit Placement Tests at:

HINU 400.title: Introduction to Hindi and Urdu Literature
HINU 400.description: Readings of various literary genres in Hindi, Urdu and their medieval equivalents. Modern fiction from India and Pakistan; the Urdu ghazal; medieval Hindi bhakti poetry; readings from the Adi Granth of the Sikhs Hindi film. Discussion in Hindi-Urdu of all materials. Recommended pre-requisite: HINU 300.

HINU 450.title: Hindi Film
HINU 450.description: Regional, religious, and historical dialects of Hindi and Urdu as represented in films. Recommended pre-requisite: HINU 200 or fluency in Hindi.
